limits: Pure-model legal plans replay through real browser controls. These prove reachable outcomes, not unaided play or fair human success probability.

Card fixtures inspect deterministic concealed/deck state during test-only planning. Native UI replay proves reachable outcomes and recovery, not information-limited optimal play or fair human win probability.
Every desktop gameplay control uses native keyboard focus/Enter; every mobile gameplay action uses touchscreen taps. Mode selection is setup via the native select API before the game begins.
Chromium desktop and emulated touch at390/320px; not a physical-phone, other-engine or screen-reader study.
Late-stage optional-mode checks are pure-model generation constraints, not full browser completion at stage10003. Independent ordinary-input review is separate.

last-contact: Only adjacent occupied enemies are destinations; capture empties source, reduces material once and settles no-contact next mover
triad-and-tower: First occupied ray blocks farther stacks; capture compares height and removes enemy material, while friendly stacking is second-action only
Merging can bury the last exposed type and cause immediate self-loss despite conserved own material
crossing-court: Rank survives boundary allegiance transfer; capture credits victim value, immediate reversal is barred and an empty court settles scores
chromatic-command: Landing color forces a specific opposite pawn; a blocked pass uses the square color and repeated blocked cycles settle
outward-and-home: Crossing extends beyond a hit, resets the enemy current leg and preserves return phase; home arrival is terminal progress
pair-breaker: Exactly two bracketed enemies leave; longer runs do not capture, removed cells reopen and capture quota is an independent win
looping-guard: A capture must cross a loop before its first enemy; paired ports turn the ray and friendly screens stop farther captures
mill-and-flight: Deployment spends reserve; mills remove unprotected pieces first, graph movement replaces placement and exactly three survivors may fly
mirrored-offensive: The passive license cannot push and only opposite-color attacks use its exact displacement; one pushed enemy can leave but a second blocker forbids the turn
marble-vault: Upper placements need all four supports; supported stones cannot move, promotions cannot remove their destination support, and legal recycling restores reserve exactly once
brimline-reserves: Outside insertion shifts mixed occupants only to the first gap; own triples recycle contiguous rows while only enemy pieces leave permanently
double-written: Closing a graph cycle forces recursive endpoint assignments and removes the component; simultaneous lines use earlier largest classical move priority
last-defense: Defense compares suit and trump; volley additions reuse a table rank, and refill is attacker-first under a nearly exhausted deck
covered-columns: Vertical equality cancels independently of value; taking discard requires replacement, while the final reveal grants exactly one opposing final turn
capital-lines: A severed territory path marks an army for a full repair window; restoring connectivity rescues it, while failing the next own-action check removes it
A reachable marked army carries its repair deadline when moving to another unsupplied cell; the next own-action check removes it exactly once
The same reachable isolation window permits a legal return to supplied territory instead of attrition, clearing the threatened army deadline
bracket-and-effort: Marginal bands tax only their income slice, endogenous hours fall under high rates and a two-period income streak trains the next wage
club-tariff: The same high fee deters a new customer but is sunk for a member; fee controls lock after admission and capacity overrun is a real failure
pooling-desk: Uniform price excludes low-risk cohorts; deductible lowers willingness and coverage, dated affordability changes later enrollment and settlement pays the selected group claims
network-tipping: Choices use the old peer state simultaneously; subsidy pays only newly switching users, and sustained adoption changes the rival response and next-period quality
bonus-and-burden: Auditing vulnerable proxy redirects chosen effort from gaming into actual quality; quality practice changes future costs and an exhausted audit is unavailable
